theme: Luxury Fine Dining (Archetype 5: Midnight Blue & Gold/Oak Accents)

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay and warm golden ambient glows

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready fullstack app with FastAPI backend and React frontend. Backend must support SQLite database with tables for reservations (atomic booking lock, date, time, guests, status, customer info, confirmation code), menu items, table/floor-plan management, AI booking assistant endpoint (Gemini 3 Flash integration via Emergent LLM key), WhatsApp Cloud API booking notifications adapter (MOCKED delivery with toggle), analytics, and tenant settings. Frontend must feature an immersive landing page for White Oak Restaurant (New Delhi, 4.7/5 stars, Sadar Bazar) with menu showcase, real-time booking widget, AI Concierge chat, customer booking lookup/modification/cancellation, and a secure Google-authenticated Admin Dashboard with reservation calendar, floor plan editor, menu management, WhatsApp settings, and real-time analytics. Ensure ALL interactive elements include `data-testid` attributes. Never use transparent headers or raw input dates; use clean modals and cards.
